goal: Every session mc launches — claude or codex, step, mend, helper, intake, plan, brief, worker or work, new or resumed — is handed its role text and nothing the tool would load on its own: no CLAUDE.md, no AGENTS.md, no auto-memory.
Its prompt-cache TTL comes from its role: `step` and `mend` 5 minutes, every other role 1 hour, whatever the billing.
Cost estimates price cache writes at the TTL they were written with.

success_criteria.criterion: A claude step launch, new and resumed, carries `--settings` with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 and CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=5m; a codex one carries `-c project_doc_max_bytes=0`.
success_criteria.check: Unit tests on `headlessArgs` in tests/mc/run-plan.test.js assert the exact argument pairs for both tools, new and resume.

success_criteria.criterion: A plan, brief, worker or work launch carries the same claude settings with TTL 1h, new and resumed, in both the foreground and the tmux launch.
success_criteria.check: Unit tests on `openInWorkArea` and `launchCommand` (through `startInBackground`) in `src/mc/work-open.js` assert the `--settings` argument and its TTL.

success_criteria.criterion: `streamSummary` prices 5-minute cache writes at 1.25× input and 1-hour writes at 2×.
success_criteria.check: A unit test feeds `streamSummary` assistant events whose usage splits `cache_creation` between `ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` and `ephemeral_1h_input_tokens` and asserts the cost.

steps.title: Role TTL and the launch switches, for both tools, at every launch
steps.done_when: Every claude launch mc makes (headlessArgs, openInWorkArea, launchCommand; new and resumed) carries `--settings` with the two DISABLE switches and the role's TTL, every codex launch carries `-c project_doc_max_bytes=0`, `step`/`mend` resolve to 5m and other roles to 1h, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: Every launch path now carries adapter.sessionArgs({cache}); role.cache comes from parseRole (step/mend 5m, else 1h). CACHE_TTL_MS is replaced by cacheTtlMs(cache) in both adapters. Step 2 (pricing by TTL) is untouched.

steps.title: Price cache writes by their TTL
steps.done_when: `estimateCost` prices 5-minute writes at 1.25× and 1-hour writes at 2× input, `streamSummary` hands it the split from each message's `usage.cache_creation`, a test asserts both, and `mc gate` is green.
